where: proof of (7.9.14), 'On en conclut (...) que F est Y-plat'
note: Checked on a 2x crop: the print has (1.4.14.5) in old-style figures; the first character is the digit 1 (x-height, the same glyph as in 14) followed by a full stop, not a bold I and a comma. The printed number is a misprint: EGA III has no (1.4.14.5) ((1.4.14) has no sub-items) and EGA I has no 4.14. The TeX's (I, 4.14.5) is neither the printed nor the correct reading; the diplomatic text takes the printed one.
